sn12.60:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Kurusu viharati Kammāsadammaṃ nāma Kurūnaṃ nigamo || || 2
sn12.60:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn12.60:1.4: yāvagambhīro cāyam bhante paṭiccasamuppādo gambhīrāvabhāso ca || atha ca pana me uttānakuttānako viya khāyatīti || || 4
sn12.60:2.2: gambhīro cāyam Ānanda paṭiccasamuppādo gambhīrāvabhāso ca ||
sn12.60:2.3: Etassa Ānanda dhammassa aññāṇaṃ ananubodhā appativedhā evam ayaṃ pajā tantākulakajātā guḷigandhikajātā muñjapabbajā bhūtā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ saṃsāraṃ nātivattati || 5
sn12.60:3.1: Upādāniyesu Ānanda dhammesu assādānupassino viharato taṇhā pavaḍḍhati ||
sn12.60:3.6: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti || || 6
sn12.60:4.2: tassa yāni ceva mūlāni adhogamāni yāni ca tiriyaṅgamāni || sabbāni tāni uddham ojam abhisaṃharanti ||
sn12.60:4.3: Evañhi so Ānanda mahārukkho tadāhāro tadupādāno ciraṃ dīgham addhānaṃ tiṭṭheyya || || 7
sn12.60:4.4: Evam eva kho Ānanda upādāniyesu dhammesu assādānupassino viharato taṇhā pavaḍḍhati||
sn12.60:4.7: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti || || 8
sn12.60:5.1: Upādāniyesu Ānanda dhammesu ādīnavānupassino viharato taṇhā nirujjhati ||
sn12.60:5.4: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hoti || || 9
sn12.60:6.3: So tam rukkhaṃ mūle chindeyya || mūle chetvā paliṃ khaṇeyya || paliṃ khaṇitvā mūlāni uddhareyya antamaso usīranāḷimattāni pi ||
sn12.60:6.6: phāletvā sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ kareyya || sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ karitvā vātātape visoseyya || vātātāpe visosetvā agginā ḍaheyya || agginā ḍahetvā masiṃ kareyya || masiṃ karitvā mahāvāte vā opuneyya nadiyā vā sīghasotāya pavāheyya ||
sn12.60:6.7: Evañhi so Ānanda mahārukkho ucchinnamūlo assa tālavatthukato anabhāvanikato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo || || 10
sn12.60:6.8: Evam eva kho Ānanda upādāniyesu dhammesu ādīnavānupassino viharato taṇhā nirujjhati ||
sn12.60:6.13: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hotīti || ||
